metadata.question: Does Somalia show lower soil moisture in April 2019 compared to the average April conditions?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Use SMAP L3 Soil Moisture (10 km, 1-day) provided as “NASA/SMAP/SPL3SMP” by GEE. - Date: April 2019 (1 – 30 Apr 2019) versus an April climatology. We will use the same product for 2015-2018 (4 complete years) to build the climatological April mean. - Location: Somalia national boundary (use a simple rectangular box that fully contains Somalia to avoid external datasets). 2. Masking strategy: - SMAP soil-moisture bands are already retrieval-masked; no extra cloud mask is needed. We will use the ‘sm’ band (surface soil moisture in cm³/cm³) and keep only pixels flagged as recommended_quality=0 (retrieval_quality_flag). 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs Null: - After masking, count valid pixels with ee.Reducer.count(). - If 2019 April or climatology has 0 pixels → C2. - If mean calculation returns None/NaN → C3. - Compare 2019 mean (2019mean) to climatology mean (climMean). - If 2019mean < climMean → A (Yes), else B (No). ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project="earthsense-436113") # 1. Geometry & Time somalia = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([40.9, -1.8, 51.5, 12.4]) # bounding box covers Somalia apr2019 = ee.DateRange("2019-04-01", "2019-04-30") aprHist = ee.DateRange("2015-04-01", "2018-04-30") # 2. Load SMAP soil moisture & mask by recommended_quality def smap_april_mean(drange, label): col = (ee.ImageCollection("NASA/SMAP/SPL3SMP") .filterDate(drange.start(), drange.end()) .select(["sm"], ["sm"]) .filter(ee.Filter.eq("retrieval_qual_flag", 0))) n = col.size().getInfo() if n == 0: print(f"{label} Images: 0") return None, 0 img = col.mean() count = img.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=somalia, scale=10000, maxPixels=1e9).get("sm").getInfo() mean = img.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=somalia, scale=10000, maxPixels=1e9).get("sm").getInfo() print(f"{label} Images: {n}, Mean SM: {mean:.3f}, Pixels: {int(count)}") return mean, count climMean, climCount = smap_april_mean(aprHist, "Hist Apr") if climMean is None: print("C1") exit() apr2019Mean, c2019 = smap_april_mean(apr2019, "Apr2019") if apr2019Mean is None: print("C1") exit() if climCount == 0 or c2019 == 0: print("C2") exit() if apr2019Mean < climMean: print("A") else: print("B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project="earthsense-436113")

# 1. Geometry & Time
somalia = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([40.9, -1.8, 51.5, 12.4])  # bounding box covers Somalia
apr2019 = ee.DateRange("2019-04-01", "2019-04-30")
aprHist = ee.DateRange("2015-04-01", "2018-04-30")

# 2. Load SMAP soil moisture & mask by recommended_quality
def smap_april_mean(drange, label):
    col = (ee.ImageCollection("NASA/SMAP/SPL3SMP")
             .filterDate(drange.start(), drange.end())
             .select(["sm"], ["sm"])
             .filter(ee.Filter.eq("retrieval_qual_flag", 0)))
    n = col.size().getInfo()
    if n == 0:
        print(f"{label} Images: 0")
        return None, 0
    img = col.mean()
    count = img.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=somalia,
        scale=10000,
        maxPixels=1e9).get("sm").getInfo()
    mean = img.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=somalia,
        scale=10000,
        maxPixels=1e9).get("sm").getInfo()
    print(f"{label} Images: {n}, Mean SM: {mean:.3f}, Pixels: {int(count)}")
    return mean, count

climMean, climCount = smap_april_mean(aprHist, "Hist Apr")
if climMean is None:
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()
apr2019Mean, c2019 = smap_april_mean(apr2019, "Apr2019")
if apr2019Mean is None:
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()
if climCount == 0 or c2019 == 0:
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    exit()
if apr2019Mean < climMean:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
